matter_background.original: Nishantha Jayakodi was allotted by the final decree of Partition case bearing No.102/P dated 25.03.2002 in the District Court of Colombo, the allotment of land marked Lot containing in extent 20 perches depicted in Partition Plan No. 808 dated 08.01.2001 made by K. N. A. Perera Licensed Surveyor. He built a commercial building on this land bearing Assessment No.12, Arunodaya Mawatha, Battaramulla. Nishantha Jayakodi upon Deed of Gift No.1012 dated 12.08.2002 attested by S. Kumarasiri Notary Public of Colombo gifted the said Lot A depicted in the said Plan No. 808 unto his youngest son Lalantha Jayakodi subject to the life interest of the donor as a gift absolute and irrevocable. Nishantha Jayakodi died intestate on 13.09.2007 leaving as his heirs his wife Kanthi and his three children Lalantha, Harsha and Dushani. Nishantha was previously married and had a child namely Minoli. His youngest son Lalantha was married to Nishi Fernando. Lalantha died on 04.10.2009 intestate and issueless. Dushani was married to Sarath and had two children namely Ashen and Tashen. Harsha I was unmarried and issueless, Harsha died intestate on 18.05.2010. 2. On the death of Lalantha Jayakodi, Kanthi filed the Testamentary Case bearing No.4620/T in District Court of Colombo to administer the estate of her late son. The Letters of Administration dated 26.12.2009 were issued to her and the proceedings were terminated on 26.04.2010.
